faqProductsDesc: Frequently asked questions about product management
faqProduct1: How can I add a new product?
faqProduct1Answer: You can add a new product by going to the Products page and clicking the 'Add Product' button. Fill in the required information such as product name, code, price, quantity, and save the product.
faqProduct2: How can I edit product information?
faqProduct2Answer: Go to the Products page, search for the desired product, then click the 'Edit' button next to the product. Modify the required information and save the changes.
faqProduct3: How can I track product inventory?
faqProduct3Answer: You can track product inventory from the Products page where the quantity of each product is displayed. You can also view inventory reports from the Reports page to see low-stock products and best-selling products.
faqOrdersDesc: Frequently asked questions about order management
faqOrder1: How can I create a new order?
faqOrder1Answer: You can create a new order by clicking 'Add Order' from the side menu. Select the customer, add the required products, specify quantities, then complete the order and payment information.
faqOrder2: How can I track order status?
faqOrder2Answer: You can track order status from the Orders page, where all orders are displayed with their current status. You can click on any order to view its full details and update its status.
faqOrder3: How can I cancel an order?
faqOrder3Answer: To cancel an order, go to the Orders page, search for the desired order, then click the 'View' button. From the order details page, you can click the 'Cancel Order' button and confirm the cancellation.
faqCustomersDesc: Frequently asked questions about customer management
faqCustomer1: How can I add a new customer?
faqCustomer1Answer: You can add a new customer by going to the Customers page and clicking the 'Add Customer' button. Fill in the required information such as name, phone number, email, and address, then save the customer data.
faqCustomer2: How can I view a customer's purchase history?
faqCustomer2Answer: Go to the Customers page, search for the desired customer, then click the 'View' button. On the customer details page, you will find a section for purchase history showing all previous orders for the customer.
faqCustomer3: How can I modify a customer's credit limit?
faqCustomer3Answer: Go to the customer details page, then click the 'Edit Credit Limit' button. Enter the new credit limit and save the changes. You can also modify this information by editing the customer data.
faqReportsDesc: Frequently asked questions about reports and analytics
faqReport1: How can I view sales reports?
faqReport1Answer: You can view sales reports by going to the Reports page and selecting the 'Sales' tab. You will find monthly sales analysis, top-selling products, and sales by category.
faqReport2Answer: On the Reports page, select the report you want to export, then click the 'Export' button at the top of the page. You can choose the export format (Excel, PDF, CSV) and then confirm the export.
faqReport3: Can I customize the time range of reports?
faqReport3Answer: Yes, you can customize the time range for reports by clicking the 'Select Period' button at the top of the Reports page. Specify the start and end dates for the desired period, then click 'Apply'.
